thread:
Rina (AE): urgent — PolarisTech CISO flagged our SQ. they require customer-held HSM attestation + proof of key non-export before any POC traffic. POC paused.
Omar (Solutions Eng): can you paste the clause? want to see if it's residency only or broader guarantees.
Rina (AE): they wrote: 
> "Vendor must provide written attestation that customer keys remain under Customer custody in an HSM (FIPS 140-2+) located in Customer jurisdiction; vendor must demonstrate integration prior to ingress of test data."
June (Security): that's beyond hosted baseline. two practical routes: (1) Private deployment + direct KMS integration and demo attestation, or (2) cryptographic envelope approach, but that may not satisfy attestation language. both need Legal check.
Marc (Platform): infra can spin a Private demo in eu-west-1 and wire their KMS via VPN/peering. ETA ~36 hours if prioritized. will need a temp service principal for handshake testing.
Ivy (Sales Lead): customer timeline: they want written confirmation within 72 hours or they'll cancel the on-site demo. escalate to execs.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a short CISO brief (network diagram + key flow) and a sanitized KMS snippet to attach.
June (Security): I'll draft a one-page attestation template and minimal redline language Legal can accept. avoid absolute guarantees.
FinanceBot: note — Dedicated/Private changes pricing. include preliminary cost delta in the invite.
Rina (AE): propose exec bridge tomorrow 09:30 PT with Polaris CISO, our Security lead, Platform, and finance FYI. I'll send invite after June confirms.
June (Security): I can join. Marc please prepare ETA + ops checklist.
Marc (Platform): on it. request artifacts: HSM model + FIPS cert PDF, short-lived test principal, allowed egress IPs.
Omar (Solutions Eng): sample sanitized KMS snippet for CISO:
```
kms_key {
  origin = "EXTERNAL_HSM"
  residency = "EU"
  usage = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT"
}
```
Rina (AE): action items: Rina schedule bridge + request artifacts; June draft attestation + redline; Marc prepare deployment ETA + checklist; Omar create CISO tech brief; Ivy loop finance and exec sponsor.
Ivy (Sales Lead): please copy Finance on the invite.
Rina (AE): will send invite now and post link here. update thread with any changes before the bridge. :thumbsup:
